description: Defines the Storage class responsible for cross-platform JSON persistence of TaskList objects, including methods for loading and saving tasks, as well as utility functions for directory management and atomic file writes.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Handles cross-platform JSON persistence with atomic saves and error recovery, managing task data storage locations depending on the operating system.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Loads tasks from the persistent storage, returning an optional TaskList.

methods.name: saveTasks
methods.description: Saves the provided TaskList to persistent storage.

methods.name: detectDataDir
methods.description: Detects the appropriate data directory based on the operating system.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that the specified directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: atomicWrite
methods.description: Performs an atomic write of content to a file, with safety and error recovery.
